TAGLINE: Three fingers. A light touch. Natural, effortless dragging.
DRAG_DESCRIPTION: Move windows and select text, without pressing down.
STARTUP_DESCRIPTION: Run in the system tray when you sign in.
GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Rest three fingers on the touchpad and drag a title bar or text.
AI_DESCRIPTION: Need help? Let AI guide you.
TIP_SETUP: Set three-finger swipes and taps to None to avoid gesture conflicts.
TIP_AI: Only two settings, once. If unsure, choose Ask AI.
FOOTER_TRAY: Closing this window keeps the tray app running. Right-click its icon to quit.
FOOTER_PAUSED: Dragging is paused. Turn it back on from the tray.
FOOTER_STOPPED: The background app is stopped. Turn dragging off and on to retry.
FOOTER_RETRY: The touchpad is unavailable. Turn dragging off and on to retry.
FOOTER_WAITING: Waiting for the touchpad to connect.
FOOTER_UNSUPPORTED: A precision touchpad and Windows 11 24H2 or later are required.
FOOTER_NO_TOUCHPAD: No precision touchpad supporting three fingers was detected.
FOOTER_DISABLED: The touchpad is off. Enable it in Windows settings.
SETUP_GUIDANCE: Disable Windows three-finger swipes and taps once.
COPY_NOTICE: Copied. Paste into a chat with an AI that can operate your computer.
COPY_ERROR_NOTICE: Copy failed. Please try again shortly.
SAVE_ERROR: Your settings could not be saved. Reopen the app and try again.
HOST_START_ERROR: The background app could not start. This window will stay open. Try again shortly.
TRAY_ERROR: The system tray is unavailable. This window will stay open. Try closing it later.
GRAPHICS_ERROR: Windows graphics could not initialize. Background dragging is unaffected.
PROMPT_UNKNOWN: The app cannot confirm these two settings. Check them in Windows settings.
PROMPT_NO_TOUCHPAD: No three-finger touchpad was detected. Check whether this computer supports it.
PROMPT_DISABLED: The app reports that the touchpad is off. Check this first.
PROMPT_STATUS: The app reports: three-finger swipes %s; three-finger taps %s.
